new_statement: Conditional cancellation-free lower modulus via the validated target addition inverse. Put e=rho+epsilon and assume e<=e_mod:=min{e_blk,1/4}, where e_blk is the universal threshold from validated node 1.1.2. Equip the fourfold target-corner direct sum with its max norm, put Z=Gamma_n(mu_n(X))=(gamma_jk,n(X_jk))_{j,k}, and write gamma_n(X)=alpha_n(Z). By the datum's lower norm bounds and validated node 1.1.1, ||Z||_max=max_jk||gamma_jk,n(X_jk)|| >= (1-rho)max_jk||X_jk|| >= (1-rho)||X||/4. Because e<=e_blk, validated node 1.1.2 applies and supplies a universal M<infinity, independent of n, such that alpha_n is bijective and ||alpha_n^{-1}||<=M. Therefore ||Z||_max=||alpha_n^{-1}(gamma_n(X))||<=M||gamma_n(X)||, so ||gamma_n(X)|| >= (1-rho)||X||/(4M) >= ||X||/(8M), since rho<=e<=1/4. The triangle inequality, the upper corner bounds, and node 1.1.1 give ||gamma_n(X)||<=sum_jk(1+rho)||X_jk||<=4(1+rho)||X||<=5||X||. Thus, conditional on e<=e_mod, c_0||X||<=||gamma_n(X)||<=5||X|| for every n and X, with universal c_0=1/(8M). No separate uniform bound on the compression maps C_jk,n is used. This node proves only the stated small-e conditional conclusion; it does not remove the root contract's missing restriction on epsilon.
